character.lede: A mid-century raised ranch stands on a park lot, its main floor a storey up behind a brick loggia. A tuck-under garage and a downstairs playroom sit below, and a terrace opens off the kitchen.

spots.line: A workbench, wall hooks and a bicycle fill the garage under the house.
Play rug, shelves and an easel fill the playroom.
A whiteboard hangs by the range, and the Core sits on the sideboard.

facts.style: Mid-century raised ranch on a city park lot: a tuck-under garage between fieldstone piers under a balcony room with a dark slat rail, the main floor a storey up behind a brick-walled loggia, pale ashlar over a dark brick base under a tall west shed and a low asymmetric east gable, a switchback picket-railed stoop through brick planters, stepping stones across a lavender cottage garden

character.truths: The Core sits on a sideboard in the Kitchen and Dining room. No kitchen island: say the counter. The main floor is a storey up; the garage and playroom are below. A whiteboard hangs in the kitchen.
mustNot: no kitchen island or breakfast bar

pi-hole: [claims] Network-wide blocking at DNS. Do not call it parental control or promise safety.
Blocks ad, tracker and bad domains at DNS: not parental control and no promise of safety

Overlaps AdGuard Home: one per household

[claims] The listing says "access it from anywhere"; do not write that (the sheet leaves remote access unfinished). Say the editor opens in the laptop's browser on the home network. Never claim it matches a hosted coding

[hardware] The listing asks for GPU passthrough for best performance and the Hub package declares no GPU device, so a given Core may not run a given game well. Say what the Core does (it runs the session at home), never

[note] Persona decision 2026-10-15 (Liam Broza): re-admitted from the old cloud-account exclusion for the gamer archetype, with the caveats above.
